title: Figure 31: US Sighting Frequency Map by 1-Degree Latitude/Longitude Grid, 1947–1952
description: Map of the continental United States, with Canada and Mexico labeled, overlaid with a grid of one-degree latitude and longitude cells. Highlighted cells contain stacked counts of sightings, and a key at lower left explains that the top figure in each cell is all sightings, the middle is unit sightings and the bottom is object sightings. An inset at lower right covers the area east of Maine. Caption: "FIGURE 31 FREQUENCY OF OBJECT, UNIT, AND ALL SIGHTINGS WITHIN THE UNITED STATES 1947-1952, BY SUBDIVISIONS OF ONE DEGREE OF LATITUDE AND LONGITUDE".
